events.title: Trump weakens fuel efficiency standards. And, Cornell fraternity rape case reopened
events.description: The Trump administration has weakened fuel efficiency standards for new cars. And, prosecutors have reopened a Cornell University fraternity rape case.

events.title: Senegal's Youth Olympics makes Olympics in Africa 'logical'
events.description: The Youth Olympics are to be hosted in Africa for the first time ever. The edition in Senegal is also a chance to prove the continent can host a full Olympics in the future.

events.title: African leaders herald $16B Dangote oil refinery in Kenya
events.description: An oil refinery on Kenya's coast is expected to be completed in 40 months, and will process an estimated 700,000 barrels of oil per day. Africa's richest man, Aliko Dangote, will lead the project.

events.title: Portugal: Ronaldo walks away
events.description: Cristiano Ronaldo has left Portugal’s training camp after several days of tensions with head coach Jorge Jesus. Portuguese Football Federation president Pedro Proença travelled to Copenhagen to try to ease the situation, without success. Ronaldo eventually missed training and left Denmark on his private jet. The five-time Ballon d’Or winner must now explain his decision.

events.title: Meet 'America': Trump’s AI chatbot changes answers after challenging his claims
events.description: Donald Trump has launched “America”, an AI chatbot designed as a digital portal for US government information. But its responses appear to be changing. The chatbot initially challenged several of Trump’s claims, including on the 2020 election and inflation, providing evidence and links. More recently, it has refused to answer some of the same questions. Other responses still contradict Trump, while some echo his views. Vedika Bahl tests the chatbot, and its varying answers in Truth or Fake.

events.title: UK-France 'one in, one out' migrant deal scrapped

events.title: Evangelical leader slams Palestinian official’s Bible claims as ‘contemptible’
